title: Slice 5 — Real calendar (CalDAV, recurring/DST) — docs/plans/magic-mirror/04-slices.md
acceptance: CalDAV discovery (well-known/OPTIONS/PRINCIPAL) resolves the calendar home for the configured server
A bounded REPORT query returns events for the configured calendars
Unit tests parse fixture VCALENDARs, including a weekly recurring event with one overridden occurrence expanding to exactly one event at that time
Unit tests verify DST-boundary expansion correctness
Only read-only DAV methods are used (GET, PROPFIND, REPORT); no PUT/DELETE/MKCALENDAR
The CalDAV app password is read only from the MIRROR_CALDAV_APP_PASSWORD environment variable
The calendar refresh interval is independently configurable
